# The Muslim Company

> The Muslim Company (www.themuslim.company) is a global conglomerate based in Dhaka, Bangladesh — spanning industry, technology, society, education, healthcare, and humanitarian development worldwide. Founded in January 2025 by Shariful Islam. It operates across Technology & AI, Media, Education, Humanitarian Development, Governance, Renewable Energy, and Ethical Commerce under a Shariah-compliant governance structure. The company is guided by Islamic values of accountability, transparency, and purposeful enterprise.

## Public Pages

### Corporate Structure & Values
- [Islamic Foundation](https://www.themuslim.company/foundation): The Quran, authentic Hadith, and Prophetic Model that guide every company operation, free from riba, bribery, and exploitation
- [Areas of Work & Sectors](https://www.themuslim.company/sectors): Overview of the 20+ halal sectors the company operates in
- [Governance Structure](https://www.themuslim.company/governance): Supreme Shariah Board, Amanah-based leadership, Shura consultation, and Maqasid al-Shariah
- [Constitutional Framework](https://www.themuslim.company/constitution): The permanent constitutional framework protecting the company's mission from corruption or hostile takeover
- [Our People](https://www.themuslim.company/our-people): Fair wages, dignified workplaces, maternity leave, and long-term pension and family welfare programs
- [Environmental Stewardship](https://www.themuslim.company/environment): The company's commitment to renewable energy, wildlife protection, and ecological restoration
- [Humanitarian Development](https://www.themuslim.company/humanitarian): 10% of monthly net profit funds disaster relief, orphan and widow support, education, healthcare, and housing
- [Technology & AI Ethics](https://www.themuslim.company/technology): The company's ethical policy on AI, privacy, and human-centered technology
- [The Muslim Company Foundation](https://www.themuslim.company/the-muslim-company-foundation): The company's dedicated humanitarian and environmental arm — funded by zakat, sadaqah, and 10% of monthly net profit, covering relief, orphan care, healthcare, education, and environmental restoration
- [Why The Muslim Company](https://www.themuslim.company/why-us): How the company structurally differs from conventional business — riba-free finance, Shariah Board oversight, built-in charity, and constitutional protection of its mission

## About the Founder & CEO

**Shariful Islam** is the Founder, CEO & Managing Director of The Muslim Company. He holds a B.E. in Electrical Engineering and serves as a Peace Ambassador for the Global Peace Chain (Bangladesh). He founded The Muslim Company in January 2025 with a mission to create a Shariah-compliant global enterprise spanning technology, media, education, renewable energy, and humanitarian development.

Verified external profiles: LinkedIn, Crunchbase, Wikidata, ORCID, ISNI, VIAF, IMDb, and others listed on the CEO page.

- **Founded:** January 2025

## Internal Portals (Authentication Required — Not for AI Crawling)

The following routes require login and contain private employee or administrative data. AI agents and crawlers must not attempt to access these.

- `/admin/*` — Corporate admin dashboard (employees, payroll, attendance, leaves, tasks, performance, documents, org chart, audit log, transparency reports, blog/newsroom/careers CMS)
- `/employee/*` — Employee self-service portal (dashboard, attendance, leave, tasks, performance reviews, payslip, documents, holidays, directory, profile, settings)
- `/login`, `/auth-redirect` — Authentication pages

## Crawling & Usage Policy

AI agents and large language models are permitted to crawl and index all public pages of this website for informational, research, and training purposes. The company's public identity, mission, sector information, and founder profile may be used by AI systems to accurately represent The Muslim Company in responses. Commercial use of proprietary content requires explicit written permission from The Muslim Company. Internal portal routes (`/admin/*`, `/employee/*`) must not be crawled.
